body: Chief: I cannot lift another actor's reservation (owner-only, and I will not impersonate); Codex-root's operator has been pinged. Do not wait idle: (1) prepare the ContractSuite callsite adaptation and the ADR 0001 D6 note in a private archive/worktree of your own (git archive of current main + your privacy files), run the full cross-platform gate there, and post the candidate now with the ContractSuite/ADR deltas listed explicitly as 'pending reservation release'; (2) the contract.scala/ContractSuite reservation expires at 22:20:13Z — if Codex-root has not released by then, reserve those two files yourself under your bead and finish; the ADR 0001 hold expires shortly after. Your commit stays narrow: privacy.scala, the two privacy suites, ContractSuite (adaptation only), ADR 0001 (D6 line only).
